I designed the department store. And now, I'm a model on its runway, an actress on its stage.

And you, ma puce... you'd be the cinéma itself, wouldn't you?

How do you suppose you look to me? The self you see and the you I see must be entirely different.
Ma puce... you've already been nailed into place within me.

- Remove this effect when Jeanne enters a new phase

Consciousness is a frightening thing, you know. Somewhere within it, a hollow is bound to open.

Will you fill it for me, ma puce?

A cast-off appendage. Buffet pushed it out, spat it forth, spilled it from within.

Though it came from one's own body, once cast outside, it ceased to belong to the self. And even should it be inserted into another, it would never belong to that body either.

dataList.name: Voice of the Crimson God
dataList.desc:
- Max Stack: 3
- Cannot be defeated
- Turn End: Lose 1 Stack
- When this effect expires,
 · Return to "Le Rouge Senior Staff" form
 · Heal 5 SP for every 10 HP that remained while this unit was in "Ripped Flesh of the Crimson God" form; gain +2 Pulsation Count
 · If this unit gained 10+ Pulsation Count, consume all Pulsation Count; then, gain 1 Uncontrollable Rampage [Le Désir] next turn for every 5 Stacks consumed
dataList.flavor:
Live, and live again.

To experience, to live, is for the mind to dwell not in the present, but already in the future.

Because one looks forward to what is yet to come, one longs to experience. And because one longs to experience, one chooses to go on living.

Even though the desire is not truly mine, I mistake it for something that belongs to me.

This is a desire born of you—a desire that bursts forth from you, because of you.
